TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror

12 Board Games
games.summary: A collection of 12 board games, including Gomoku, Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, Chinese Chess, Reversi, Draughts, Four in a row, Shogi, Jungle Chess, Junqi, Nine Men's Morris, and Mancala.

games.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
games.summary: First-person zero-gravity billiards where you ARE the ball. Fire energy pulses to sink your targets — but every pulse kicks you backward: recoil is your only engine. Nothing slows down in the sealed arena, so it winds itself up. Your skill is the window of control before the chaos takes over.

games.name: About Frontlines
games.summary: A turn-based strategy game built on total freedom. Design your own maps, forge your own units, and set your own rules of war. Build and play every era you can imagine. Quick, tense, tactical battles against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

games.name: After the Wane
games.summary:
The new interactive graphic novel by the creators of Along the Edge and Across the Grooves.

Lena is a starry-eyed young dancer with big dreams, but as soon as she sets foot in the capital, she finds herself at the nexus of a lifelong quarrel between Fernand, the elusive director of a community center, and Deborah, who's leading the troupe of a strange and exclusive theatre. Does it have anything to do with her mother, a dancer too, who abandoned her when she was a child?

Torn between her past and her future, Lena will need to rediscover her own nature and forge her path forward as increasingly strange events unfold around her... but the strangest of all might be the permanent commentary of a voice that she seems to be the only one to hear.

games.name: Akuro and Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters
games.summary: Brick-building auto-battle Roguelite. Pick a character, explore random labyrinths, collect Combat Bricks to boost stats and Legendary Bricks with special effects. Dozens of enemies, a corruption system, multiple endings, and exclusive Defeat CGs for every character-monster combo.

games.name: Amusement Factory
games.summary: **SPRING SALE! 75%** Hurry, this sale ends soon!*********************************************************************************Beware! This Game Will Introduce You to New Levels of Awesomeness!*********************************************************************************Play, challenge your friends, Win! New Race 2013 HD, will take your breath away with its new innovations and amazing features. Make sure you play online to gain access to the latest content and features, and to ensure that your profile is backed up online. games.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
games.summary:
In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

Command thousands of units in real time across continent sized battlefields. Use Strategic Zoom to orchestrate movements from orbit to frontline and shape the terrain as you fight - not just to conquer, but to restore. As structures crumble and terrain turns to or from Turinium, witness the real-time transformation of warzones into reminders of your impact.

Ashes of the Singularity II is the sequel to the ground-breaking 2016 game that envisioned a near future where strong AI would lead to profound changes to our way of life. The aftermath would lead to a battle for control of our solar system and beyond across three key factions: humans, post-humans, and AI.

games.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
AXIS FALL
games.summary: Fallock is a very relaxing top-down puzzle game where knowledge and discovery are key. Explore a minimalist maze, fall to reach new areas, and collect every number.

games.name: Aztec Escape
games.summary: Aztec Escape is an endless 2D pixel-art platformer set in an ancient temple. Use simple controls and precise timing to dodge deadly traps, collect ancient relics, and beat your highest score.

games.name: Black Hole Simulator
games.summary: Gaze into nature's greatest abyss. Explore a real-time black hole simulation with true gravitational lensing, a volumetric accretion disk, orbiting worlds, and cinematic relativistic effects.

games.name: Block Garden
games.summary: A 3D puzzle game about bringing jelly blocks together. Blocks of the same color stick when they touch, and once they're stuck they move as one piece. Push them around small islands with a cat until each color is joined up.

games.name: Breeding Pit
games.summary: You are the Dark Lord. Breed an orc horde in the pit beneath your tower, where every whelp inherits real genes from its sire and dam. Send them to war in retro turn-based battles, and raise a dynasty strong enough to put out the Light.

games.name: Carom Crashers
games.summary: Bank shots beat direct hits — x1.5 off one wall, x2 off two. A 4-player party shooter where you read angles like billiards. Couch party: plug in a pad, press A; friends join free via Remote Play Together. Full bot matches, online quick match, 12 weapons, 6 arenas, mutators.

games.name: Carve The Cave Together
games.summary: Dig a cave with a friend, one cell at a time. Throw balls into solid rock in zero gravity and they never stop, so the more cave you open the further everything flies. Mine ore, feed the machine, unlock a roster of balls that each dig differently.

games.name: Clay Crusade: Night of the Necromancer
games.summary: Hack N' Slash zombie survival horror game featuring a claymation art style set in fantasy world. Upgrade your arsenal and fight through hordes of zombies to stop the evil necromancer and return peace to the kingdom!

games.name: Containment Shift Company
games.summary: Run a supernatural factory alone or with up to 9 friends. Care for unpredictable creatures, turn their materials into goods, and meet rising company quotas. Haul cargo, monitor the facility, and survive blackouts and containment breaches together.

games.name: Cozy Marbles - Jelle's Marble Runs Supporter Pack
Crossing Space Zen
games.summary: Explore space in a small ship guided by inertia and gravity. Find water, protect your hull and master each landing. Journey through 18 handcrafted crossings in search of a new home, or choose your own route in the open world of Drift.

games.name: Crystalase
games.summary:
Turn crystals into masterpieces.

Crystalase is a relaxing puzzle game. Players assemble beautiful images made entirely of sparkling crystals. Each level involves placing crystal pieces in the correct positions to gradually reveal intricate, colourful artwork.
Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.
Crystalase is perfect for puzzle lovers and anyone who enjoys creativity, focus and a touch of sparkle.

games.name: Cubic Color Confusion
games.summary: Cubic Color Confusion is a grid-based puzzle game where every move reshapes the board. Manipulate the environment and guide your cubes through ever more intricate puzzles to recover valuable artefacts from the ruins of a lost civilization. Can you master every challenge?

games.name: Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin
Dave: Leg it
games.summary: Quick, save the world! Erm, no. Dave is a rude little demon with a shotgun and zero interest in heroics, but the Evil Essence is in his way. Sprint, swing and blast through 16 lightning-fast levels where every second counts and "one more go" is never just one.

games.name: DAWN AEROWAR
games.summary: Dawn is an animated feature film, not a game. One final mission for a fighter pilot driven by revenge against the Empire that took everything from him. 3D animation, 2D art and an audioplay story. Full voice cast, original score. Nearly two hours in 12 episodes.

games.name: Dear Gravity
games.summary: Fold a little hope. Let it fly. Read the wind, refine your paper plane and feel the quiet triumph of a difficult delivery landing just right. From your first window launch to a letter at the lighthouse, go a little further with every throw.

games.name: Deep Digger
games.summary: Your dog buried your homework, so you are digging up the planet to find it. A pixel-art mining incremental: dig, sell, upgrade, prestige, go deeper. 19 ores, sealed treasure caves, portals to other dimensions, and a neighbour who pays for odd jobs in junk.

games.name: DEEP SEAL
games.summary: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.

games.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Fog of War
Disk Defragmenter
games.summary: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.

games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
games.summary: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

games.name: Drawmi: Terraform Sim
games.summary: An alien planet terraforming sim where you can draw all of the plants, animals, and bugs that you use to make a thriving ecosystem.

games.name: Drawmi: Twin Stick
games.summary: An action-packed twin stick arena shooter where you can draw all of the enemies, players, weapons, and obstacles.

games.name: Echoes (Salty0x)
games.summary: Record your movements and turn the past into a path. Your echoes activate mechanisms and become platforms in midair. Solve 36 single-player puzzle-platforming levels in a mysterious, surreal world, with optional hints to guide your journey.

games.name: Edge of the Blade
games.summary: Edge of the Blade is a roguelite grand-strategy autobattler where you choose one of three factions and fight over the ruined land of Cheonggu. Set weekly war objectives, capture strongholds, deploy your army, and shape the flow of battle through your choices.

games.name: EEL KNOW:Perfect Pitch
games.summary: A garden eel's length is your clue to the pitch! Guess sounds on the keyboard to train your absolute pitch. Correct answers add eels with unique sounds to your encyclopedia. Create custom quizzes, unlock new instrument tones, and send them to friends to sharpen your ears together!

games.name: Expiration
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror strategy where diabetes becomes a deadly table duel. Balance blood sugar with insulin, manage your supplies, and defeat Doctor Dealer to claim the cure.

games.name: First Light (Ephphatha Games)
games.summary: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

games.name: Football Manager 27
games.summary: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in FM27, as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a richer footballing world to explore.

games.name: Ghost Receipt - A Cyberpunk Pawnshop Simulator
Ghosts Before Dawn
games.summary: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.

games.name: Glims
games.summary: Welcome to Piano Touch. Tap to play, chose from two different piano's. Play background music while you play your piano. Isn't it great now you have your own piano all on your iPhone/iPod/iPad.

games.name: Great Space Race of 3032
games.summary: Test your piloting skills in a top-of the line space racer. Match up against others in the matchmaking mode, compete against AI, or your own personal best times. Race the timer, clear as many rings as you can, and clear the finish line to lock in your time, top speed and accuracy.

games.name: Gridiron Grit
games.summary: A deep pro-football General Manager sim. Run one franchise's front office against 31 rival GMs: draft the steals, dodge the busts, work the cap, manage the locker room, and chase a dynasty over decades. You build the roster but your players take the field.

games.name: Grindveil
games.summary: A free idle MMORPG that keeps playing while you do not. Pick a class, send your hero into the Rifts, and come back to full pockets. Then spend it on arena duels, guild wars, and a server wide faction war that shifts the world every week.

games.name: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO
games.summary: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!

games.name: HAMSTER WHEEL ISEKAI
games.summary: I died. I reincarnated as a hamster. Now I must break the world speed record. A pixel-art gear-shifting wheel racer and incremental RPG that starts cozy... and ends at the speed of light.

games.name: HELIX ARK
games.summary: Adam has crash-landed on an alien world with Eve, a human restoration device. Rebuild civilization from a single human, develop cities, and combine technology with cultures unlocked through alien diplomacy to fuel explosive population growth in this sci-fi incremental simulation.

games.name: Hillbilly Racing
games.summary: Hillbilly Racing is a silly first-person tractor race across the farm! Dodge chickens, cows and angry bulls, hit hay bale ramps, plough through barn shortcuts and drink moonshine for a boost. Race by night, in split screen or online with friends, and unlock ridiculous hats!

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary:
Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. 

But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. 

Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

games.name: Horde Highway: Zombie Survivors on Wheels
games.summary: A bullet heaven roguelite on wheels: plow through thousands of zombies, evolve your car into a rolling arsenal, and survive the drive. 10 cars, evolving weapons, 40 stages across 4 worlds, a boss at the end of every stage.

games.name: I nailed this document!
games.summary: How picky can a client be? Match document layouts, fix unruly text, and line up every detail in this office puzzle game. “Just one little tweak!” Handle changing references, scrambled layouts, and papers blocking your view. Can you deliver without getting it sent back?

games.name: Infall: A Black Hole Incremental
games.summary: A short, relaxing incremental game about growing a black hole. Start smaller than dust, end swallowing galaxies.

games.name: Kamiyo
games.summary: A dystopian visual novel about Gods, humans and the 'Godkillers'. Pray to your God, and death to the Godkillers.

games.name: La Agencia del Riel
games.summary: The Rail Agency assigns a mission to Alena, who—along with the gaucho Don Orlando Soles and Pachomba—must prevent the theft of the "Train of the 7 Colors" in Jujuy. This is a multidirectional shooter that can be played solo or in a cooperative multiplayer mode for up to 3 players.

games.name: Lestvitsa
games.summary: A free isometric detective game in the tradition of Disco Elysium. Investigate the theft of an icon, explore the world, and talk. Conduct your investigation through dialogue, skill tests, and choices. Set in a northern Russian town, it's a blast from the nostalgia of the 2000s.

games.name: Lucky Hell
games.summary: A hidden casino that opens at night — no invitation required. Roll your dice into poker hands, twist the odds with charms and engravings, and beat 36 escalating nights. The House is always smiling.

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge.

Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt.

games.name: Mates and Crates
games.summary: Steal crates, drop them on your crafting pad and turn them into guns, vehicles and squadmates. Team battles online or against bots: blow up the enemy HQ before they blow up yours.

games.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished
games.summary: Turn pain into power with The Punished, a new clan joining the fight in Monster Train 2! Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished introduce a new risk-reward play style built around damaging your own units, harnessing their suffering, and turning it against your enemies.

games.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space
games.summary: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: Northmen
games.summary: A pixel-art strategy game of the Viking Age. From AD 793, lead Norse raiders and settlers across a real map of the world: raid monasteries, besiege walled towns, raise halls and trade routes, and win a saga worthy of Valhalla.

games.name: Nova Protocol
games.summary: Drift, drag, slide ! 'Turbo Skiddy Racing' makes racing even tougher than ever.You race against up to 7 cars and truck. As an experienced racer, you will have to manage driving your car on bumpers and jumps, narrow roads and even ice (on night and day tracks). Don't let you get overtaken by the fast computer driven cars, avoid collisions and win the championships!The game is built on the best vehicle physics engine available for real driving sensations and a very effective computer driven cars artificial intelligence system. It features high definition 3D graphics, along with rock musics and realistic sound fx.If you like car games, this one is different, this one is for you!3 championships included.

games.name: OREBELT
games.summary: Rocks roll in, you crack them open, coins pile up! OREBELT is a cozy idle miner where your little mine slowly grows into a mega factory, from coal and iron to blood diamonds, jade and more.

games.name: PARLEY
games.summary: A medieval free-for-all RTS for 2–8 players where talk is a weapon. Drive an ARPG-style Lord, build your village, command squads, send voice messages by raven, forge alliances, then betray them. Last stronghold standing wins.

games.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense
games.summary: Path Defenders is a 3D action tower defense RPG. Build a strategy party and jump into real-time combat to fight alongside your summoned heroes against epic bosses, all driven by a lofi and vaporwave soundtrack.

games.name: Pest Termina ~ Swarm Deffense
games.summary: Build your base turn by turn on a hex world map, then drop into real-time battles against thousands of alien creatures. Command marines, robots and tanks, fortify the gates with turrets, and survive 50 days of an evolving swarm in this low-poly defense roguelike.

games.name: Piggy Monte
games.summary: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

games.name: Pit & Pat
games.summary: Pit & Pat is a chaotic online aerial football game where you cast spells, steal goalposts, and occasionally score a goal. Win matches in ways that would put real footballers to shame.

games.name: Poopcremental Farm
games.summary: Poocremental Farm is a short and funny incremental game about turning nature’s least glamorous product (literally - poop) into a rapidly growing business empire. Are you dedicated enough to get the "Golden Farm" award?

games.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist Soundtrack
Potion-Making: Path of the Alchemist Supporter Pack
Project Hole
games.summary: A cosy digging game set in a British back garden. Shovel, pick and drill through turf, clay and rock, sell every load, upgrade your tools and build ladders, belts and lifts as you dig hundreds of metres down to unearth treasures, crystal caves, lava and a buried secrets. Dig alone or with friends.

games.name: Project Motor Racing: World Endurance Pack
Protocell
games.summary: If you’re a fan of “Hello Kitty”, then we’re sure you like playing this game.Dress up Kitty with all her favorite items of clothes, soft toys and other!Good game for girls and kids because Kitty is funny.

games.name: Quadora
games.summary: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.

games.name: RENSE
games.summary: THINK YOU KNOW YOUR ARSENAL TRIVIA? Prove it in this easy to use addictive quiz. * Guess the whole 2013 squad * Guess Arsenal Shirts Year * Guess the 175+ Appearances Players * Guess the previous Managers Name * Guess the Managers First Year * Guess the Trophy * Guess the PL Shirts * Guess the PL Shirt Year * Guess PL Players 6 levels. Can you really complete it all? DOWNLOAD TODAY AND START THE FUN All rights, content and trademarks are owned by their respective owners and not associated to fun-apps.

games.name: RIFTGROVE
games.summary: Explore a shifting fantasy world in Riftgrove, a 3D action RPG featuring four playable classes, fast-paced combat, procedurally generated wilderness, dangerous dungeons, rare relics, and powerful Champions. Return to Haven, take guild contracts, and venture through the next portal.

games.name: Rulebound
games.summary: Trapped between reality and the Void, your only escape is a strange disc-merging game on an old CRT TV. Bounce discs and stack upgrades to forge 3 Golden Discs. Strange entities are watching, and breaking the rules is a death sentence.

games.name: Safe Zone: A Cozy Post-Apocalyptic Game Demo
Sala Manager
games.summary: Master the hardcourt in Sala Manager, a high-speed futsal simulation where football meets lightning-fast chess. Solve intense tactical puzzles, execute 5v5 real-time rotations, and build an indoor tycoon empire. Small court. Relentless pace.

games.name: Scramshaw
games.summary: The definitive pirate-themed roguelite word game. Use letters from your grid to make words that move you along the treasure map, then obtain tools and powerful charms to keep the expedition going. With a pool of over 300 effects to discover, every run is unique and sometimes there's a coconut.

games.name: SKY REAVER
games.summary: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.

games.name: Smashboom
games.summary: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

games.name: Softfall
games.summary: A totally addictive tile puzzle game!!!Your job is to solve the puzzle by shifting the colored tiles to match the pattern given in as few moves as possible.It's as simple as that and hugely addictive.

games.name: SOMNIMAZE
games.summary: That night, after playing a maze, I dreamed I was in one. Find your way through five mazes and wake up to a refreshing morning.

games.name: SPACE BUMPS: A Bad Space Day
games.summary: Wil only wanted to fix his ship and go home. Now a corporate rescue scheme is threatening an entire station. Solve inventory puzzles, repair strange machines, follow the evidence and face the executive responsible in this sci-fi comedy adventure.

games.name: Speed King
games.summary: Race as anything from pigs to firetrucks in a chaotic 3D racer where every competitor has unique abilities and every track brings unexpected challenges.

games.name: Starlight Cove
games.summary: Make some lemonade and set sail in this cozy fishing incremental game. Catch weird fish across colorful locations, upgrade your gear, rebuild Starlight Cove back to its former glory, and defeat the evil shark that stole your grandfather's greatest treasure years ago.

games.name: Stelvyr: Colony Defense
games.summary: Build and defend a space colony where every unit of power and every crew assignment matters. Expand production, research new technologies, shape the battlefield with walls and weapons, and adapt your strategy against alien swarms across nine campaign operations.

games.name: Sting Operation
games.summary: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed! Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!

games.name: Sumverse
games.summary: Power your spaceship with number puzzles in Sumverse. Swap and stack cores, match row and column totals, and connect numbers into an unbroken trail. Brave cosmic hazards, deliver troublesome cargo, and upgrade your ship as you save for a bigger family home.

games.name: SUSPECIES
games.summary: SUSPECIES is a multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where aliens sculpt and paint themselves to blend into crowds. Hide from the friend hunting you, or take the stage in the SUSPECIES Show and sculpt against your friends or with your team. Don't be sus.

games.name: Swarmbreaker
games.summary: The struggle to protect the ancient ninja scroll of Knowledge and Power has always been a task for the strongest and pure of heart, and one such ninja exists, Katsuo the Stick Ninja. For many years Stick Ninja has been the protector and keeper of the ancient scroll. He has learned its ways and vowed to use its power to help the needy and defend the weak. What Stick Ninja does not know is that an evil force is being conjured to find the scroll and take it from its keeper. The struggle to protect the scroll may cost Stick Ninja more than he knows. With his Dragon Princess kidnapped, and the scroll’s location compromised, he must find Akemi, the Dragon Princess, and still protect the scroll from Evil. The Stick Ninja quest begins…Save the Dragon Princess and the Ancient Scroll of Knowledge and Power from the evil leader of the Crane Warriors, Kasuki.

games.name: Tai Chi Tarot
games.summary: In the game world You control a super metal ball As needed Looking for super property licensing Changed to Four kinds of attributes form Break down barriers The triumph Very simple Come and try.

games.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends.

Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
The last keeper
games.summary: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

games.name: The Last Tree (Faytz Games)
games.summary: One tree. An entire ecosystem to grow. Build your defenses, unleash spores and summoned allies, and survive relentless waves of pests in this incremental defense game. Earn permanent upgrades and help the last tree grow stronger with every cycle.

games.name: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut
games.summary: The Light in the Darkness: Director’s Cut is a free narrative game following a Polish-Jewish family living in Nazi-occupied France.

games.name: The Little Cloud
games.summary: You’re a little cloud with a big job. Soar over the cozy seaside town of Peace Wind Bay as its newest sky courier: deliver parcels, give rides, and rain on the places that need it most. Make friends, bring wilted fields back to life, and on Rainbow Day, paint the sky for everyone.

games.name: The Rookie Prince's Defense Trials
games.summary: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!

games.name: The Sea is Our Stage
games.summary: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

games.name: Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 7 - Vans
Treasure Hunt Dungeon
games.summary: A free adventure idle single-player hero game where you defeat enemies, collect treasures, challenge dungeon bosses, enhance equipment, and forge your own combat style. With hundreds of talents to choose from, Please note that it is entirely in Chinese and not in English

games.name: Urban Float
games.summary: Urban Float is an endless 2D pixel-art platformer set in a city atmosphere. Use simple controls and precise timing to dodge obstacles, collect strawberries, and beat your highest score.

games.name: Veiled Legions: Fantasy Board Game
games.summary: Lead a hidden army in a tactical board game of bluff and deduction. Your rival can't see your units until combat when clashes become animated duels. Outwit a bot, a Steam friend, or an online rival and seize the enemy Relic.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Warpack
games.summary: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills — forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

games.name: WDR:window rush
games.summary: Ultimate mini idle tower defense! Cute pixel heroes are waiting to join you in defending against data invasions – right inside your desktop popups. Use an extensive variety of tower combinations and your brilliant tactical setups to fend off the boredom of everyday life!

games.name: Wheel Be Fine
games.summary: Spin and upgradeWheel Be Fine is a cozy incremental clicker about turning a simple idea into something much bigger. Start small, make things happen, and watch your progress grow as you keep clicking, upgrading, and pushing your wheel further. Build up your progress, unlock new possibilities, and keep improving your setup. Every upgrade helps you go a little further, making the next step faster, bigger, and more satisfying. Discover new hamstersMeet and unlock a growing collection of weird, wonderful, and ridiculously cute hamsters. From adorable to strange and hilarious, there’s always a new hamster waiting to join the gang. Keep progressing, discover them all, and see just how many different hamsters you can collect.A cozy world with a sense of progressionCute visuals, relaxing vibes, and small details make every bit of progress feel rewarding. The world around you changes as you advance, giving you that satisfying feeling of seeing your efforts come to life. Keep spinningClick. Upgrade. Grow. Then do it all over again. How far can you take it?

games.name: When Life Gives You Lemons (DamianDevz)
games.summary: Run your own neighborhood lemonade stand! Mix ingredients, craft the perfect recipe, squeeze fresh juice, and keep your customers happy. Order fruits, furniture, and equipment, unlock upgrades and grow your stand into the ultimate business empire.

games.name: Woke Busters
games.summary: The world has gone mad and the only man who can fix it skipped leg day. WokeBuster is a satirical cartoon adventure through the culture war: puzzles, minigames, Buzzlings to catch and a cast with permanently unhinged faces. If one joke offends you, it's working.

games.name: Zomking
games.summary: Hunt zombies, collect powerful loot, and grow stronger in this third-person action RPG. Find pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and equipment with randomized stats and effects, build your character, fight through five increasingly dangerous stages, and ultimately challenge the Zomking.

games.name: A Snail's Tale
games.summary:
It's called A Snail's Tale - that might lead you to believe that the snail is the main character, but nay, friend. The player takes control of Samson Spligglebarp, the noble descendant of a famed historian who is eager to make his own mark on the world.

Samson travels to the Halite Kingdom to enter King Phillippe's challenge, competing against other adventurers for a chance to be a Halite Warrior. The King reveals that he is eternally pursued by an immortal snail who will never rest until he is destroyed.

And so begins the quest of Samson and his intrepid companions, the Halite Warriors, to gather the three Crystals of Power and stop the snail before he catches the King.

games.name: A to Zen: Cozy Anime Puzzle
Buzzopolis: Hive Incremental
games.summary:
Buzzopolis: Hive Incremental is an incremental roguelite colony sim in pixel art style.

Build a thriving hive, upgrade your colony, and experiment with resources and strategies. But beware: mutations accumulate, cells become infected, and eventually, it's easier to blow it all up. Activate the Phoenix Protocol, keep your bonuses, and start a new, stronger cycle.

Progress, chaos, and a bit of humor - all in one hive!

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary:
Castlebound is a thrilling roguelike action game where you and your allies must defend a walking castle while battling relentless waves of monstrous foes.

Join Lenora, a skilled archer, and her wise grandfather Vargus as they awaken an ancient structure that transforms into a living fortress.

Guided by the enigmatic Coronya, they must gather powerful warriors to fight the malevolent forces threatening the realm.

games.name: Desktop Mate STREET FIGHTER 6 CHUN-LI DLC
Desktop Mate STREET FIGHTER 6 RYU DLC
Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary:
17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

Hope in the City is a narrative mystery game, set in the Chinese city of Shenyang, by the team behind the 2026 GDC Best in Play Winner Sky of Tides and the Annie Award-nominated Eternal Spring. Play as Hope, a 17-year-old girl investigating her parents' disappearance, connecting the clues and uncovering the truth hidden beneath the city's calm.

NO NOTE NO WARNING
You come home from school like any other day. But the house is too quiet. Your parents are gone, the apartment is in shambles. No note, no warning, no answer. Hope Song is 17, and she's just become the only person willing to ask what really happened.

AN ARTIST’S EYE
Hope isn't a detective. She's an artist. And that's exactly what makes her dangerous to whoever's hiding the truth. Every room holds details that don't add up: a shadow in the wrong place, an object that shouldn't be there, a lie in someone's eyes.

Capture what you see as sketches in Hope's notebook. Every detail matters.

FROM OBSERVATION TO TRUTH
Connect what you've seen into insights, and push those insights until they crack open into breakthroughs. Piece by piece, sketch by sketch, the picture of what happened to your parents starts to take shape, and it's darker than you imagined.

A CITY FULL OF SECRETS
Shenyang isn't just a backdrop, it's a character of its own. Rendered in a bold, stylized art style with an edge, every street, storefront, and shadowed alley is begging to be explored. Wander past neon signs and quiet corners alike, and let the city's striking visuals pull you deeper into its secrets.

WHO CAN YOU TRUST?
On the surface, it's just home: familiar streets, quiet neighbors, ordinary life. But beneath Hope's peaceful existence, secrets are buried. And now it's her time to find the truth.

games.name: Love in Summer – 2K HD Video Resource Pack
Love in Summer – 4K Ultra HD Video Resource Pack
MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
Neon Impact 360 - Muliplayer Arcade Action
games.summary: Four walls. Four paddles. One ball that never slows down. Defend your wall in a neon arcade showdown where every goal you let in brings you closer to defeat — across 30 levels of gravity wells, pinball chaos and mind-bending illusions, solo or with three friends.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: Retro Shop: Tidy Up the Video Game Store!
Springs, Eternal
games.summary:
Springs, Eternal is a lo-fi first-person story exploration game in an evocative visual style recalling the dithered and pixelated graphics of late ‘90s-era PC and home console games. Immerse yourself in this eerie, half-remembered otherworld, its dark, winding paths at once inviting and unsettling.

Meet over a dozen unique characters, each with their own reasons for being at Stillwater Springs: the philosophers engaging in a debate that could last a lifetime; the tattooist waiting to inscribe you with your future; the old men, the widow, the young lovers -  branching dialogue reveals who they are, how their stories relate to your own, and what other secrets Stillwater might be hiding…

games.name: The Lacuna Tapes: Analog Signal Archive
Three Kingdoms: Wardens of the Pass
Void Reaver
games.summary:
You're stranded on a crumbling alien planet with nothing but your weapon and an empty backpack. To survive this sci-fi bullet heaven, you’ll need to master the art of aggressive organization and nimble movements.

Climb a towering alien monolith while facing hordes of enemies, collect experimental tech and jigsaw your inventory into an unstoppable engine of destruction. 

The Void is waiting, and your inventory space is limited.

games.name: White Whisper
games.summary: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

games.name: 天堂世族網路遊戲 (Royal Lineage Online)
BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.summary:
Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games in this cozy and creative game. Barbie Rewind pulls you back in time through iconic eras of Barbie with stunning pixel art and retro style. Your bestie, Barbie, invites you into her world and entrusts you to update her DreamHouse with your unique style, using items from 65+ years of Barbie history.

Choose from three retro DreamHouse designs for your exterior facade, walls, and floors. You can even mix-and-match them from room to room. Style each room with a fabulous collection of furniture, decor, and accessories, inspired by real Barbie playsets throughout the decades. From a classic pink vanity to a ‘90s inflatable chair, make the DreamHouse unique to your style and creativity.

Barbie has also left you her game collection of 16 Barbie video games from 1991 through 2007. Titles include Barbie Pet Rescue, Barbie Horse Adventures: Blue Ribbon Race, and the never-before-released game, Barbie: Vacation Adventure. Play through the collection to complete additional quests and unlock more items.

games.name: Can You Beat The AI God?
Choice of Life: Modern Ages Soundtrack
Delve Survivors
games.summary: A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

games.name: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO Soundtrack
I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing
Idle of the Dead: Radio Host
Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
Midnight Rest Stop | 深夜ドライブイン
Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Pixel Coloring World – Pixel Adventures Vol. 2
Sonic Pico Park
games.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

games.name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. Soundtrack
Persona 4 Revival
games.summary:
In the rural Japanese town of Inaba, the once sleepy streets receive a cold wake-up call when a mysterious serial killer strikes. Also, what's with the rumor of a mysterious TV channel appearing only on rainy nights? 

A whirlwind of surprises and otherworldly adventures will make the next year of your high school life anything but ordinary!

Persona 4 Revival intertwines an investigation into a string of murders with the journey of self-discovery and encounters with the occult, all within a critically acclaimed, classic RPG experience - reborn in a new form!
